desc: The extended UTG PRO Monolithic M-LOK Handguard for MP5 and MP5K pattern firearms extends past the front sight and features short Picatinny rail sections and a full-length Picatinny flat top. It is compatible with most 9mm cylindrical suppressors and QD tri-lug muzzle devices, and was developed for military and law enforcement users who run Picatinny-mounted lights.
